exposure: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) serum levels
Soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 (sFlt-1) serum levels
outcome: Distinction between placenta accreta and placenta increta
cohort: The study included 140 patients with pernicious placenta previa (56 with placenta accreta/increta and 84 without) and 46 pregnant women without PPP who underwent caesarean section as controls.
finding: Serum levels of VEGF and sFlt-1 can serve as auxiliary indicators to diagnose pernicious placenta previa and to distinguish between placenta accreta and placenta increta.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of diagnosis or delivery
